hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.jsonc|*.css|*.svelte|*.html) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/biome" check --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.md) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --log-level warn --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
